title: The Spirit Bathhouse
subtitle: Live class · Basic math (addition and subtraction)
story: The great spirit bathhouse's biggest tub is filthy, and only bundles of magic bath herbs can clean it. Earn bath tokens at the token stall and the wardrobe, and spend them to fill at least one of the small baths.
